items.stem: Which of the following best describes "Voronoi vertex"?
options: A point where three or more cells meet; it is equidistant from the three nearest sites
Finding the point in a region that is as far as possible from every site, i.e. the centre of the largest empty circle
A segment of a perpendicular bisector forming the boundary between two cells
At equal distances from two or more points
items.answer: A point where three or more cells meet; it is equidistant from the three nearest sites
items.markingKey: A. "Voronoi vertex" is a point where three or more cells meet; it is equidistant from the three nearest sites.

items.stem: Which of the following best describes "perpendicular bisector"?
options: A point where three or more cells meet; it is equidistant from the three nearest sites
A division of the plane into cells, one for each site, where every point of a cell is closer to its site than to any other site
The line through the midpoint of a segment AB at right angles to AB; every point on it is equidistant from A and B
Finding the point in a region that is as far as possible from every site, i.e. the centre of the largest empty circle
items.answer: The line through the midpoint of a segment AB at right angles to AB; every point on it is equidistant from A and B
items.markingKey: C. "perpendicular bisector" is the line through the midpoint of a segment AB at right angles to AB; every point on it is equidistant from A and B.
